rationale: Base case with l13 out of service results in l12 overloaded at 133.3% (100 MW / 75 MW rating). Closing l14 provides an alternative path from b1 to b4, reducing flow on l12 to 70.71 MW (94.3% of rating). All other candidate actions (opening l23, l24, or l34) result in other branches being overloaded. Closing l14 is the only feasible corrective action that maintains connectivity and keeps all branch loadings within emergency ratings.
